method: Full (theta, sigma) unprofiled-deviance Satterthwaite t and F tests

failure_policy.boundary_or_unstable_derivatives: retained as unavailable and never redrawn
failure_policy.optimizer_or_numerical_failure: retained as unavailable and never redrawn
failure_policy.test_denominator_failure: retained as unavailable and never redrawn
failure_policy.calibration_denominator: available tests only, with a separately gated unavailable rate

required_cases: sleepstudy ML and REML one-DF and two-DF

release_claim: Calibrated only for the declared regular Gaussian random-intercept regime; boundary and numerically unstable fits return unavailable rather than fabricated degrees of freedom.
